Google MediaPipeTasks 1.2.2. Unmodified binary downloads and integration sources.
Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/5b6fea33b95a78ae3dc61f4ed96a2f7df85a672e
Binaries downloaded by SwiftPM with upstream SHA-256 checksums.

Local integration: -ObjC retains Objective-C classes and helper categories.
Every kicklab app configuration uses config/MediaPipePose.xcconfig to retain
specific registration units from MediaPipeTaskGraphs_library.a with -u symbols,
instead of force-loading every task graph and optional backend in that archive.
The app currently uses only CPU PoseLandmarker video mode with the Full model.
Unrelated MediaPipe task graphs and GPU inference registrations are not retained.
Do not add another task/delegate without reviewing and testing its dependencies.

pose-link-anchors.json records the object member and unique public symbol for
60 required/supporting graph, calculator, stream-handler and executor units. The
selection follows the upstream pose_landmarker, pose_detector and regular_tflite
image_preprocessing BUILD dependencies, including stream helpers and inference
CPU/XNNPACK calculators. Core handlers and warp-affine registration were verified
with actual graph initialization and video inference. Optional branches of the
pose graph are retained even when output segmentation masks are disabled.

Verify both original SDK slices and regenerate linker settings after a deliberate
catalog edit with:
python3 scripts/verify-mediapipe-pose-linkage.py --sdk-root "<DerivedData>/SourcePackages/artifacts/mediapipetasks" --write-config
Without --write-config, the script checks the generated settings too. It checks
archive hashes and that each symbol uniquely belongs to the recorded object in
both device and simulator libraries. A changed SDK must be reviewed again.
The xcconfig belongs to the app only; propagating its private C++ entry points
to hosted test bundles via SwiftPM causes undefined-symbol errors.

The binaries, pose model, CPU options and counter rules are unchanged. Any SDK or
linkage change must pass MediaPipeLinkageTests against a full-graph baseline:
real footage plus tracking loss, reacquisition and fresh sessions, in Debug and
Release. Also run ShoeContactRecoveryTests and the home navigation smoke test.
Merely linking or launching is insufficient because ShoeContactRecovery can fall
back after errors. To obtain a full-graph diagnostic baseline, temporarily replace
the xcconfig's anchors with -Xlinker -force_load -Xlinker followed by the quoted
$(BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR)/MediaPipeTaskGraphs_library.a path; keep -ObjC in this package.
